items.title: SK海力士纳斯达克IPO首日涨13%至168美元，筹资265亿美元创外国公司赴美上市历史纪录
items.summary: SK海力士7月10日以149美元/股在纳斯达克IPO，首日收报168.01美元（+13%），总募资265亿美元（出售1.779亿ADS）超越阿里巴巴2014年的250亿记录；常规交易7月13日起以永久代码SKHY开盘，当日一度回落逾6%；公司是HBM市场领头羊，约50-55%市占率，为英伟达Blackwell/Rubin系列最大供应商。
items.why: SK海力士是持仓标的（港股CSOP两倍做多ETF相关）；纳斯达克上市提升流动性与国际曝光，HBM4E送样叠加SKHY挂牌，短期可能对港股相关ETF产品带来活跃交易机会。

items.title: 美国稳定币法GENIUS Act监管框架7月18日正式生效；Circle同步获批全国信托银行牌照
items.summary: 2025年7月18日签署的GENIUS Act进入合规实施阶段，一年过渡期今日届满，联邦层面稳定币全面监管框架正式生效（涵盖储备要求、披露规则、发行人牌照与持有人保护）；Circle同期获OCC批准开设First National Digital Currency Bank，USDC进一步确立机构级合规地位；美联储新稳定币监管规则同步出台。
items.why: Circle/CRCL是持仓标的；今日是关键监管事件落地日，短期可能引发CRCL股价波动（合规确定性VS新资本要求）；长期监管明确利好USDC机构采用规模化。

items.title: 小米YU7正式发布起售价25.35万元，雷军宣布新一代SU7销量夺冠，2027年进军欧洲
items.summary: 小米正式发布YU7车型，起售价253,500元；7月购车权益：YU7享科技舒享套装限时优惠6500元，YU7 GT综合权益最高7.9万元，SU7 Ultra提供5年0息融资，活动持续至7月31日；雷军宣布新一代SU7销量居细分市场第一，小米汽车计划2027年进入欧洲市场。
items.why: 1810.HK是核心持仓；YU7定价25.35万超出部分市场预期，有助于提振毛利率预期；雷军的欧洲2027声明是里程碑式出海叙事，可能带来短期估值溢价。

items.title: Bloomberg：谷歌Gemini 3.5 Pro发布滞后数月，Alphabet股价7月17日跌约4.4%，市值蒸发约2000亿美元
items.summary: Bloomberg报道谷歌旗舰AI模型Gemini 3.5 Pro的发布进度较原定时间落后数月，引发市场对Google AI竞争力的担忧；Alphabet股价7月17日下跌约4.4%-4.5%，单日市值缩水约2000亿美元；此前已面临搜索反垄断上诉及版权诉讼双重压力。
items.why: GOOGL是持仓标的；Gemini延迟加剧与OpenAI/Anthropic的AI差距感知，搜索广告业务护城河受到质疑；短期情绪压制股价，可关注covered call的权利金收益机会。

items.title: SOX半导体指数7月17日跌4.3%收11876，距高位回落19%，全球芯片股市值蒸发3.3万亿美元
items.summary: 费城半导体指数（SOX）7月17日下跌4.3%至11876.50点，自6月22日历史高点已累计下跌19%，仅差1个百分点即触及熊市定义；全球半导体股市值累计蒸发约3.3万亿美元，30只成分股全部下跌，资金大规模轮动至金融、能源和工业板块。
items.why: 持仓含英伟达、SK海力士、美光、Intel等半导体核心标的，板块系统性下行直接压制持仓市值；sell put策略需重新评估下行保护位。

items.title: 中际旭创通过港交所上市聆讯，拟募资约70亿美元，或成2026年港股最大IPO
items.summary: AI光模块龙头中际旭创7月17日通过港交所上市聆讯，路演后募资目标从50亿上调至约70亿美元（约546亿港元），或超越立讯精密成今年港股最大规模IPO；中金、广发、高盛为联席保荐人。公司800G光模块全球市占超40%，为英伟达最大光模块供应商；Q1 2026营收194.96亿元（+192% YoY）、净利57.35亿元（+262% YoY）。
items.why: 中际旭创是AI算力基础设施核心供应商，其成功上市将进一步增强港股科技板块吸引力，对腾讯、科技板块整体具有正向催化；也为AI供应链估值提供新参照。

items.title: 港股7月17日全线下挫：恒生指数跌1.78%至24562，恒生科技指数跌4.37%
items.summary: 7月17日（周五）恒生指数收报24562.24点，下跌446.36点（-1.78%）；恒生科技指数单日跌4.37%，科技板块成最大重灾区，背景为全球半导体股连续大幅下跌。指数已连续两日回调，16日曾涨2%至25174.79点。
items.why: 港股科技板块集中承压，对持仓腾讯、美团、小米、泡泡玛特等权重港股构成直接拖累；4%以上的单日科技指数跌幅可能触发期权Delta对冲需求上升。

items.title: 美光（MU）7月15日跌约7%：中国CXMT拟85亿美元IPO扩大DRAM产能，叠加HBM出口管制传言
items.summary: 中国存储芯片厂商CXMT宣布拟在国内筹募85亿美元IPO以扩大DRAM生产，引发竞争格局担忧；同时市场传出美政府可能对HBM产品实施新出口管制，两项利空叠加导致Micron（MU）7月15日大跌约7%；KeyBanc随后将目标价从1600上调至1750美元，认为存储市场紧缩将持续至2027年。
items.why: MU是持仓标的；CXMT扩产是中长期供给侧不确定性，HBM出口管制若落地将直接影响MU高毛利段的销售预期；7%单日跌幅值得关注sell put的保护性调整需求。

items.title: Intel 18A制程良率升至85%，斩获英伟达/AMD/OpenAI设计导入，18A-P进入风险量产，股价+4.5%
items.summary: 英特尔7月15日公布18A制程良率已达85%（接近台积电N2的90%，大幅领先三星SF2约55%），正式宣布获得AMD、英伟达、Marvell、微软、Micron、OpenAI等重要代工客户设计导入；18A-P（性能增强版）进入风险量产，同功耗下性能提升9%或同性能下功耗降低18%；INTC当日收涨4.5%（此前月内因18A良率问题曾大跌21%）。
items.why: INTC是持仓标的；18A良率突破85%是Foundry业务存亡的关键里程碑，大客户设计导入（尤其英伟达）可能带来中长期代工收入；建议持续跟踪18A量产节奏。

items.title: 小米规划增程SUV新系列「澎程SkyNomad」，拟推五座与七座两款车型
items.summary: 据报道，小米汽车计划推出全新增程式SUV系列「SkyNomad 小米澎程」，以区别于SU7/YU7的纯电驾驶定位；澎程系列初步规划推出五人座和七人座两款车型，拓展家用大空间赛道，预计进一步扩大小米汽车的目标客群。
items.why: 增程赛道在国内增长迅速，小米切入此赛道将进一步拓宽汽车业务规模；中长期对1810.HK营收和估值具有积极意义。

items.title: 美国AI芯片出口管制6月全面升级，中国企业境外子公司采购英伟达/AMD先进芯片须申请许可
items.summary: 2026年6月，美国BIS发布新指引明确：向中国大陆/澳门注册实体及其境外母公司控制的海外子公司出口先进AI芯片，均须申请许可证，堵塞此前存在近一年的监管漏洞；同期美众议院通过法案禁止中国企业通过云计算远程调用美国AI算力；中国加速推进华为昇腾、寒武纪等国产替代路线。
items.why: 对英伟达（NVDA）、AMD的中国市场营收产生直接负面影响；对腾讯、阿里等AI基础设施扩张形成约束；利好国内AI芯片替代路线相关A股标的。
items.source: VOA中文 / 新浪财经 / 安全内参

items.title: 英伟达FY2026全年营收2159亿美元（+65%），数据中心占比91%，远期PE约23倍创近7年最低
items.summary: 英伟达FY2026全年营收2159.4亿美元（同比+65%），其中数据中心1940亿美元（+75%），占总营收约91%；当前市值约4.7万亿美元，远期PE约23倍（历史5年均值约72倍），估值罕见低位表明盈利增速持续超越股价涨幅；Rubin架构预计提前约两季推出；公司获得客户确认的AI芯片需求承诺超1万亿美元（至2027年）。
items.why: NVDA是持仓标的；超低远期PE与千亿级别订单确认为逢低策略提供估值支撑，结合当前SOX板块系统性下跌，或为sell put/逢低买入期权策略提供较好时机窗口。

items.title: AI Memory Chip Stocks Tumble: SK Hynix -13%, SanDisk -12%, Micron -5% as CXMT IPO Looms
items.summary: SK Hynix fell 11.5% in Seoul and ~13% in US premarket; SanDisk (SNDK) sank 12%; Micron (MU) fell 5%+ as China's CXMT 295B-yuan STAR Market IPO spooks investors. Memory stocks have dropped 20%+ from recent highs, entering a technical bear market despite TSMC's strong results.
items.why: 存储芯片股进入技术性熊市，SK海力士(7709.HK)、美光(MU)直接持仓受损；CXMT上市后竞争格局压力是主要叙事，期权隐含波动率显著上升

items.title: TSMC Q2 2026: Record Revenue $40.2B (+33.7% YoY), AI/HPC Now 66% of Sales, N2 Ramp on Track
items.summary: TSMC Q2 revenue reached $40.2B (top of $39-40.2B guidance), up 33.7% YoY, driven by surging AI demand. HPC platform grew to 66% of revenue. N2 technology ramping; additional N3 capacity investments in Taiwan, Arizona, and Japan. Strong Q3 outlook issued.
items.why: 台积电强劲业绩验证AI芯片需求持续旺盛，但未能阻止存储股下跌说明资金正从存储切向先进制程；英伟达AI算力供应链逻辑获强化

items.title: Netflix Q2 2026 Earnings: Revenue Slight Miss, Weak Q3 Outlook Send Shares Down 8%+
items.summary: Netflix Q2 revenue $12.6B grew 13% YoY but slightly missed consensus; Q3 revenue growth guided at 12% (deceleration). Shares tumbled 8%+ after-hours on growth slowdown concerns. Full-year 2026 guidance narrowed to $51-51.4B.
items.why: 流媒体龙头增长减速，Q3指引低于预期触发估值重估，高IV环境对科技股期权策略有警示意义，卖put时注意高溢价标的盈利风险

items.title: Fed Chair Warsh Testifies: US CPI at 4.2%, Rates Held at 3.5%-3.75%, July Hike Probability ~25%
items.summary: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh completed two days of Congressional testimony. CPI hit 4.2% YoY (highest since April 2023); Fed holds rates at 3.50%-3.75% for 4 consecutive meetings. CME FedWatch assigns ~25% probability to a July 29 rate hike. Warsh dropped traditional forward guidance in favor of data-dependence.
items.why: 高利率维持格局不变，七月加息风险仍在，全球估值压力延续；对sell put策略需留意高利率环境下delta对冲成本上升

items.title: Apple Intelligence Gets China Regulatory Approval with Alibaba Qwen & Baidu AI; BABA Shares Jump 7.9%
items.summary: Chinese regulators approved Apple Intelligence for launch in China via partnerships with Alibaba (Qwen AI) and Baidu. Qwen will power AI text/image features on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Vision Pro in China. Alibaba US ADRs surged as much as 7.9% on the news, with Hong Kong shares up 3.26%.
items.why: 通义千问嵌入苹果生态，Alibaba(9988.HK/BABA)获得亿级iPhone用户入口，是AI商业化最重磅催化；在港股大跌背景下阿里逆势走强，基本面分化明显

items.title: CXMT Opens Subscription for China's Largest 2026 IPO: 29.5B Yuan on STAR Market, H1 Net Profit Set to Top 50B Yuan
items.summary: ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) opened STAR Market subscription July 16, targeting 29.5B yuan (~$4.3B) -- 2026's largest A-share IPO and STAR Market's second-biggest ever. Q1 revenue surged 700%+ YoY; H1 net profit projected >50B yuan. Priced at 8.66 yuan/share, global DRAM market share 7.67% (4th worldwide).
items.why: 中国本土DRAM龙头上市释放供给竞争信号，直接压制SK海力士(7709.HK)、美光(MU)估值；A股半导体板块短期受益，但全球存储行业供需结构重塑

items.title: 港股午评：恒指跌1.98%失守25000点 科指跌4.04% 科网股、芯片股普跌
items.summary: 截至午间，恒生指数跌1.98%报24514点，恒生科技指数跌4.04%。美团跌超6%，快手、哔哩哔哩跌超5%；兆易创新跌超8%；药明合联跌超9%。昨夜美股芯片股大跌为主要拖累。
items.why: 港股全线重挫，持仓腾讯、阿里、美团等均受拖累；芯片板块尤为惨烈，关注是否为超卖机会或趋势性转弱

items.title: US Bitcoin ETFs End 10-Day Losing Streak with $221.7M Inflow; White House Plans High-Level CLARITY Act Meeting
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw their largest daily haul in two months at $221.7M, ending a 10-day losing streak (worst June on record for these ETFs). Separately, White House is planning a high-level meeting with senators on CLARITY Act crypto market structure legislation to resolve remaining sticking points.
items.why: 比特币ETF资金回流信号正面，对Circle(CRCL)/加密板块情绪有支撑；CLARITY Act若通过将为加密资产分类和交易提供监管框架，是加密赛道系统性里程碑

items.title: 雷军宣布新一代小米SU7本月正式发布并启动大规模交付；YU7享7月购车限时优惠
items.summary: 雷军宣布新一代XIAOMI SU7将于7月内正式发布，随后启动大规模交付。小米汽车累计交付已超65.5万辆（上市24个月）。YU7 7月优惠：科技舒享套装6500元限时折扣，赠3000元车漆优惠券。
items.why: 小米汽车交付创新高是1810.HK估值修复的核心催化；新SU7上市刷新产品力，叠加YU7促销，有助于维持月交付量稳定增长，中长期持股逻辑得到强化

items.title: 央行发布上半年金融数据：M2增8%，社融余额462万亿，企业贷款利率降至约3.0%
items.summary: 2026年上半年，人民币贷款增加10.72万亿元，债券融资增加8.51万亿元。M2余额356.71万亿元，同比增8%；社融规模余额462.06万亿元，增7.4%。新发放企业贷款加权平均利率约3.0%，同比低约20BP。
items.why: 信贷降速提质，流动性充裕但货币政策空间仍在；对持仓A股影响中性偏正，企业融资成本下行有利盈利改善预期

items.title: 美团-W(3690.HK)股价连跌，外资大行逆势上调目标价：最高隐含40%潜在涨幅
items.summary: 美团在港股科技股普跌中跌幅居前（今日跌超6%）。财联社报道外资大行逆势上调美团明年目标价，最高潜在涨幅达40%。Keeta中东扩张持续（沙特、卡塔尔、科威特、阿联酋），巴西上线延期。
items.why: 美团估值已至阶段性低位，外资目标价上调提供逆向买入逻辑；Keeta海外营收增量有望缓解国内外卖竞争压力，是中长期逻辑支撑，卖put时需注意短期下行风险

items.title: US Launches 5th Straight Day of Iran Strikes; Hormuz Largely Shut; Brent Surges Near $125
items.summary: U.S. military conducted a second wave of strikes on Iran on July 15 targeting coastal installations. Iran retaliated with missiles at U.S. bases in Jordan. Hormuz shipping largely halted, pushing Brent crude near $125/barrel (wartime high). Iran warns Hormuz is a "red line."
items.why: 霍尔木兹危机推油价至战时高位，通胀预期强化，美联储维持高利率更久；直接冲击全球能源成本、出行需求（携程）及宏观风险情绪，港股/A股防御资产受青睐。

items.title: ASML Q2 Sales Beat at €9.3B; 2026 Guidance Raised to €43–45B Driven by AI Chip Demand
items.summary: ASML posted Q2 2026 revenue €9.3B and net income €2.9B, exceeding consensus. Full-year guidance raised from €36–40B to €43–45B; Q3 guided at €11–12B with gross margin 55–57%. CEO said AI-driven demand for advanced logic and memory chips is strengthening industry growth.
items.why: ASML指引大幅上调验证AI资本开支周期持续，上游半导体设备需求旺盛利好英伟达、SK海力士、美光等持仓的估值逻辑，也抬高了板块期权的隐含波动率底部。

items.title: TSMC Q2 Revenue $40.2B +36% YoY; Net Profit +77.4%; Raises Full-Year Guide to >40% Growth; TSM Falls 4%
items.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Q2 2026: revenue $40.2B (+36% YoY), net income +77.4% YoY, gross margin 67.7%, net margin 55.6%. Full-year USD revenue growth outlook raised from >30% to >40%. Announced $100B Arizona investment. Despite record results, TSM shares fell ~4% as investors questioned AI valuation.
items.why: 台积电史上最强季报叠加指引上调，AI代工需求无虞；但股价逆势下跌揭示当前市场焦点在于AI估值气泡担忧，是本轮芯片板块回调的核心叙事背景，影响英伟达、SK海力士等期权定价。

items.title: Netflix Q2 Revenue $12.6B +13%; Q3 Guide $12.86B Misses $13B Consensus; Stock Drops 8%+ After-Hours
items.summary: Netflix Q2 2026: revenue $12.6B (+13% YoY), operating margin 33%. Q3 guide of $12.86B missed $13.00B consensus, signaling a second consecutive quarter of decelerating growth. Ad revenue targeted ~$3B for full year. Stock fell 8%+ in after-hours trading on July 16.
items.why: Netflix盘后大跌8%+，Q3增速进一步放缓预示流媒体赛道成长动能减弱；对消费科技股的情绪产生溢出影响，提示迪士尼DIS等流媒体+主题公园的成长股估值风险。

items.title: EU Forces Google to Share Search Data with OpenAI and AI Rivals Under DMA; Android Must Open to AI Competitors
items.summary: EU regulators on July 16 ordered Google under the Digital Markets Act to share search ranking data with OpenAI and other AI chatbots, and to open Android to alternative AI services — effective July 2027. Germany's ZAK also ruled Google AI Overviews are subject to media law. Google warned of "harm to European users."
items.why: 欧盟DMA监管是谷歌搜索护城河的结构性打击，搜索广告（占总营收55%）竞争格局将长期恶化；短期影响有限（2027年起），但动摇了GOOGL长期估值逻辑，需调低GOOGL期权的乐观假设。

items.title: Nasdaq 100 Falls 1.6% on Chipmaker AI Valuation Concerns; Asia Futures Point Lower July 17
items.summary: Nasdaq 100 fell 1.6% on July 16 led by chipmakers as investors questioned whether massive AI capex spending justifies current valuations. Asia futures slipped 0.3% pre-open July 17. DeepSeek chip-building plans and concerns about AI infrastructure ROI added pressure. TSMC beat earnings but shares fell 4%.
items.why: 纳指+芯片板块AI估值回调波及亚洲开盘，港股科技（腾讯、阿里、小米）面临开盘压力；但大幅回调也可能创造sell-put入场机会，需观察市场情绪是否过度。

items.title: Gold Falls Toward $4,000/oz Near 8-Month Low; Oil Near $125 on Hormuz Crisis Erodes Safe-Haven Demand
items.summary: Gold retreated toward $4,000/oz — near its lowest since November 2025 — as surging oil prices strengthened expectations the Fed will keep rates higher for longer, reducing non-yielding gold's appeal. Despite Middle East escalation, analysts note 'geopolitical fatigue' as the dominant price driver. Brent crude traded near $125.
items.why: 金价持续走软直接压制老铺黄金（6181.HK）业绩预期；油价高位则间接影响全球消费信心及出行行业（携程）；整体风险偏好偏防御。

items.title: 腾讯混元Hy3正式版发布；元宝Agent免费上线；微信AI智能体小微灰度测试；2026年AI投入翻倍超36亿
items.summary: 腾讯7月6日发布混元Hy3正式版，日均Token消耗量较Hy2增长20倍，OpenRouter全球调用量排名第一。元宝同步上线免费Agent功能（可生成PPT/Word/Excel等）。微信AI智能体「小微」进入灰度测试，依托14亿月活生态，商业化预期升温。腾讯2026年混元+元宝AI投入超36亿元并计划翻倍。
items.why: 腾讯AI产品线快速推进：混元模型竞争力全球可见、元宝商业化路径明确、微信AI若正式推出将新增流量变现入口；整体支撑腾讯估值持续重估，期权sell-put可维持当前水位。

items.title: Intel Foundry Begins Mid-July Layoffs: 15–20% of Fab Staff (~8,000–10,000 Jobs)
items.summary: Intel Foundry started laying off 15–20% of its manufacturing workforce in mid-July (8,170–10,890 affected globally), part of broader 25,000-job reduction under CEO Lip-Bu Tan. Foundry division head cited cost challenges. Strategic focus shifts toward engineering talent and priority projects over manufacturing headcount.
items.why: 英特尔晶圆代工大规模裁员暴露其18A工艺商业化进度滞后，对AI芯片代工竞争格局构成边际影响；持有INTC的策略需更新估值假设，当前裁员更可能是成本优化而非业务复苏。

items.title: 泡泡玛特较高峰腰斩55%；段永平斥15.89亿港元成第二大股东；上海玩具展取消；Labubu新系列二级承压
items.summary: 泡泡玛特（9992.HK）7月10日报150.7港元，较2025年8月高峰312港元累跌55.7%，市值蒸发逾千亿港元。投资人段永平斥约15.89亿港元增持至1.059亿股成第二大股东。公司取消2026年上海玩具嘉年华（原定7/24-8/2，历史上仅疫情期间取消）。Labubu「复古理发店」新系列普通款二级市场跌破发行价。
items.why: 段永平逆势大举入股是重要价值信号，但Labubu二级市场降温+展会取消揭示需求端实质性放缓；股价已腰斩，适合中长期观察新IP催化剂，短期sell-put需极宽安全边际。
items.source: 自由财经 / Yahoo Finance Taiwan

items.title: Trip.com Q2 Guide Just 3–8% Revenue Growth (vs Q1 +17%); Stock Falls 12.6% to 52-Week Low; SAMR Probe
items.summary: Trip.com Q1 2026 revenue +17% YoY to $2.4B; international bookings +65%, inbound +90%. Q2 guide of 3–8% growth shocked investors; shares fell 12.6% to 52-week low, market cap halved to ~$26B from $50B peak. Headwinds: high oil prices, geopolitical disruption to airline routes, SAMR anti-monopoly investigation.
items.why: 携程Q2增速骤降+监管双重利空使股价跌至52周低点，中东局势若持续推高油价将进一步压制出境游复苏；SAMR调查悬而未决，持仓期权策略需调低执行价以保留安全空间。

items.title: SanDisk SNDK Plunges 15%+ on July 15 After Being S&P 500's Best Stock +707% YTD; Goldman PT $2,200
items.summary: SanDisk (SNDK), the S&P 500's top performer at +707% YTD, fell over 15% on July 15 amid broader AI chip selloff. Goldman Sachs maintained Buy and raised 12-month price target to $2,200 from $1,200 (20x normalized EPS of $110). Stock had gained 3.4% on July 10 from SK Hynix Nasdaq IPO sentiment.
items.why: SNDK极端波动（YTD+707%后单日-15%）体现AI存储板块高Beta特性；Goldman目标价$2,200提供下行保护参考，但高度集中的AI叙事溢价使回调风险非线性；期权隐含波动率处于高位，适合谨慎的sell-put而非激进入场。

items.title: DeepSeek Building Own AI Chips, Rattling Nvidia Pre-Market; Rubin Architecture to Arrive Ahead of Schedule
items.summary: Reuters reported July 7 that DeepSeek is developing its own AI chips to reduce Nvidia dependence — NVDA fell ~1.6% in premarket. Nvidia's Rubin architecture (previously targeted 2027) now expected nearly two quarters early. FY2026 revenue $215.94B (+65% YoY); data center +75%; Blackwell sold out through mid-2026; $1T confirmed purchase commitments through 2027.
items.why: DeepSeek自研芯片消息短期扰动情绪，但Blackwell卖断+$1T确认需求+Rubin提前构成护城河；Nasdaq AI整体回调可能带来更好的期权sell-put入场时机，需等待情绪稳定后再操作。

items.title: Tesla Q2 2026: Delivers 480,000+ Vehicles, 13.5 GWh Energy Storage; Q2 Earnings Due July 22
items.summary: Tesla produced 450,000+ and delivered 480,000+ vehicles in Q2 2026, with 13.5 GWh energy storage deployed. Earnings report scheduled July 22; analyst consensus projects EPS growth of 17.5%. Stock at ~$394. Wells Fargo raised its PT but maintained Underweight. U.S. EV market share stabilized at ~43.9%.
items.why: 特斯拉Q2交付超预期且7/22业绩临近，期权隐含波动率将走高；财报前建议观望，业绩后视情况再考虑sell-put；EV市场份额企稳是阶段性正面信号。

items.title: Interactive Brokers Q2 Earnings Due July 21; Consensus EPS $0.59 (+15.7% YoY), Revenue $1.66B
items.summary: IBKR will announce Q2 2026 results July 21 at 4pm ET. Consensus: EPS $0.59 (+15.7% YoY), revenue $1.66B (+12.2% YoY). Q1 2026 was a record with net revenues $1.67B (+17% YoY). In June, IBKR expanded AI agentic trading with ChatGPT and Grok integration.
items.why: IBKR明日业绩，期权IV crush风险；Q1创纪录背景下此次预期温和，建议财报前不新增期权仓位；AI交易工具扩展是差异化竞争亮点。

items.title: Costco Q3 FY2026: Membership Income +10.7% YoY; Renewal Rate 92.2%; Revenue $69.15B +11.6%
items.summary: Costco Q3 FY2026 revenue $69.15B (+11.6% YoY); net income +15% to $2.19B; EPS $4.93 missed $4.98 forecast by 1%. Membership fee income $1.37B (+10.7% YoY); 92.2% renewal rate; 82.9M total memberships (+4.1% YoY). Executive membership penetration grew 9.6% — stronger adoption of the higher-margin tier.
items.why: 好市多会员续费率92.2%创新高，高端消费者向折扣渠道转移趋势支撑防御属性；EPS小幅不及预期为正常季节性波动，不改长期持仓逻辑，sell-put策略可维持。

items.title: 老铺黄金较高峰市值蒸发逾1100亿港元跌60%；金价下探$4,000支撑叙事弱化
items.summary: 老铺黄金（6181.HK）近期报380-391港元，较2025年7月高峰1108港元累计跌幅超60%，市值蒸发逾1100亿港元。国际金价自1月高位大幅回调，近期跌向$4,000/盎司，市场强化「老铺与金价高度绑定」叙事而非独立奢侈品溢价。分析师平均目标价865港元，19/21评级仍买入。
items.why: 金价+品牌溢价双重叙事受挑战，股价已下跌60%；若油价高通胀环境推动金价反弹则有修复机会，但当前趋势下激进期权策略风险较大，建议保守观望。

items.title: TAL Education to Report Q1 FY2027 Results on July 30, 2026
items.summary: TAL Education Group (好未来) will release Q1 FY2027 financial results (ended May 31, 2026) before market open on July 30, with a conference call at 8am ET. No guidance or pre-announcement issued as of July 17. Company has been focusing on AI-powered learning tools including the Xueersi tablet.
items.why: 好未来7/30业绩在即，AI学习硬件市占是否持续扩张是观察核心；期权策略建议业绩前保持低仓位，等待数据验证。

items.title: 7月16日收盘：美股收高道指涨150点 谷歌等大型科技股推动股指上扬
items.summary: 美股周三收高：道指+150.37点(+0.29%)报52658点，纳指+0.62%报26269点，标普500+0.38%报7572.40点。亚马逊、微软、Alphabet均涨约3%，苹果涨4%；6月PPI意外环比下降0.3%，降温通胀令市场降低对美联储加息预期。
items.why: 美股科技板块普涨、PPI超预期降温，整体风险偏好改善；但半导体板块逆势承压，sell put在科技名单存在浮盈需注意delta调整。

items.title: Strait of Hormuz Crisis Threatens Global Trade, IEA's Birol Says
items.summary: IEA Executive Director Fatih Birol warns the global economy faces renewed peril if the US-Iran conflict choking the Strait of Hormuz is not resolved within weeks. Just 6 vessels were tracked crossing the strait in an 18-hour window versus 18–22 crossings per day earlier this month.
items.why: 霍尔木兹通道中断将推高全球能源成本，对消费、交通（携程出行需求）及大宗商品定价形成冲击；石油服务板块短线受益，能源波动率上升利于期权方向性操作。

items.title: Intel Foundry Hits 85% Yield, Winning Chip Orders From AMD, Nvidia, OpenAI as ASML Validates High-NA EUV
items.summary: Intel's 18A process node yield improved from ~65% to 85%, surpassing the commercial viability threshold, backed by ASML validation of Intel as the first company shipping high-volume chips via High-NA EUV. Design wins from AMD, Nvidia, OpenAI, and Apple were reported; Intel stock rose 4.5% with KeyBanc upgrading to Overweight, target $155.
items.why: 18A良率突破是英特尔代工业务的关键里程碑，将重估晶圆代工市场格局；INTC估值向上修正概率增大，7月23日财报为下一催化剂——sell put策略可考虑在业绩前布局。

items.title: Micron Drops 8% on China Competition Fears, Dragging Intel, AMD, and Marvell
items.summary: Micron (MU) shares fell 8% to $903.50 as Chinese DRAM maker ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) filed for an $8.55 billion IPO — set to become the world's fourth-largest DRAM producer — and reports surfaced that Apple is testing CXMT chips for China-market devices. Intel, AMD, and Marvell fell 6–7% in sympathy.
items.why: CXMT冲击令存储定价权受损叙事实质化，MU/SNDK均为持仓或关注标的；同时AMD/INTC连带下跌，可能为期权sell put策略带来正向时间价值机会。

items.title: Tencent HY3 Tops OpenRouter Charts: 6.13 Trillion Tokens Weekly, Surpassing DeepSeek V4 and Xiaomi MiMo
items.summary: Tencent's Hunyuan Hy3 (a 295B MoE open model released July 6) claimed #1 on OpenRouter's weekly LLM usage leaderboard with 6.13 trillion tokens processed, surpassing Xiaomi MiMo-V2.5 and DeepSeek V4 Flash. The free-tier offer drove the surge; Hy3 shows leading performance in coding and agentic tasks.
items.why: 腾讯AI大模型竞争力显著提升，混元Hy3的全球调用量第一是重要里程碑，可提升腾讯云AI业务收入预期；这也强化了0700.HK在AI赛道的估值叙事。

items.title: 港股午盘：恒指跌0.47%、科指跌1.42%，油服股逆势涨，中概股普涨名创优品涨逾9%
items.summary: 港股早盘走势分化：恒生指数跌0.47%，科技指数跌1.42%，科网股及芯片股普跌；石油服务股受美伊冲突推动油价上涨而逆势强势。美国上市中概股（港股通方向）普涨，名创优品涨超9%，哔哩哔哩涨超5%。
items.why: 港股科技与大盘同步受压，但中概股结构性走强，可关注持有的港股标的（腾讯、美团等）是否受波及；油服板块受益于地缘危机。

items.title: SanDisk (SNDK) Breaks $1,500 Support on China NAND Competition Fears; Shares Down 5.7%
items.summary: SanDisk (SNDK) fell 5.71% on July 15, breaching the critical $1,500 support level amid the same Chinese memory competition worries driving Micron lower. SNDK is now down 28% from its 52-week high despite year-to-date gains of 508%; the stock is tied to NAND pricing dynamics with Kioxia joint fab operations also under scrutiny.
items.why: 闪迪与美光同受中国NAND产能威胁冲击，两者均为关注名单标的；SNDK期权隐含波动率或上升，短期sell put需谨慎对待支撑破位后的进一步下探风险。

items.title: U.S. confirms Nvidia H200 AI chip exports to China begun; ~10 firms approved for up to 75,000 chips each
items.summary: Commerce Dept confirmed H200 exports to China are underway but described volume as 'trivial.' ~10 Chinese firms approved (Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance among them) for up to 75,000 chips each via Nvidia, Lenovo, or Foxconn. Total approved volume under 200,000 chips. A 25% tariff applies. Lawmakers pressing on 'Blackwell loophole.'
items.why: H200出口许可是中国AI基础设施的重要突破：直接利好英伟达短期订单，阿里/腾讯获批加速云AI投入，对两者HK持仓均为正面催化；关注NVDA期权IV走向。

items.title: Xiaomi officially launches SkyNomad EREV brand targeting Li Auto; July EV deliveries exceed 30,000
items.summary: Xiaomi launched SkyNomad (小米蓬程) as its EREV sub-brand on July 14, targeting Li Auto L-series and Huawei Aito. First model is a 5.3m+ SUV with 1,500km+ combined range and pop-up roof camping edition. Total July EV deliveries (SU7+YU7) exceed 30,000; cumulative YU7 deliveries reached 258,232 since June 2025 launch.
items.why: 小米汽车7月突破3万辆/月交付门槛，SkyNomad新增程品牌将估值空间进一步打开；今日小米股价涨超6%是市场用脚投票；sell put安全垫充足。

items.title: Google Gemini 3.5 Pro launches tomorrow (July 17) after full architectural rebuild; Alphabet Q2 earnings July 22
items.summary: Google DeepMind rebuilt Gemini 3.5 Pro from scratch after scrapping 2.5 Pro architecture due to failures in recursive tool-calling and SVG generation. New architecture targets 2M-token context and Deep Think Reasoning. Competing against OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol and Grok 4.5 (both launched July 9). Alphabet Q2 earnings due July 22.
items.why: Gemini 3.5 Pro明日发布+财报下周，形成双重催化窗口；若AI能力获认可，GOOGL财报前IV将上升，可考虑财报前sell straddle或short strangle策略。

items.title: SK Hynix soars 13% on Nasdaq debut with record $26.5B foreign listing; full-year 2026 HBM4 supply already sold out
items.summary: SK Hynix raised $26.5B in the largest-ever US listing by a foreign company (July 10), opening at $170 vs $149 issue price (+14%), closing +13%. Market cap hit $1.25 trillion. HBM4 supply for all of CY2026 is sold out. Company is now moderating HBM4 ramp to redirect capacity toward higher-margin conventional DRAM.
items.why: SK海力士美股上市是HBM超级周期的「机构确认」事件；HBM4全年售罄+DRAM资源倾斜，证明存储周期延续，对美光/闪迪持仓均为强力正面验证。

items.title: Micron: AI memory demand drives record results and long-term HBM contracts; 2026 HBM capacity fully sold out
items.summary: Micron's recent quarterly results set records driven by AI memory demand. HBM capacity for all of CY2026 is sold out. HBM4 shipments for Nvidia Vera Rubin are ramping at 2x the pace of HBM3E. 16 Strategic Customer Agreements with take-or-pay terms signed. HBM TAM projected to exceed $100B by 2027. Stock recovered +4.24% on July 14.
items.why: 美光HBM产能全年售罄+take-or-pay长约，提供极强下行保护；HBM4加速量产是下半年最重要的催化剂之一，sell put仓位安全垫充足。

items.title: 证券时报：美财长Bessent称中国将接受恢复Section 301关税税率，中国6月出口创2021年来最快增速
items.summary: 美国财政部长Bessent暗示中国将接受恢复Section 301关税税率，市场解读为中美贸易实质性缓和信号。中国6月出口同比创2021年以来最快增速，主因AI设备需求爆发与关税抢运效应叠加。
items.why: 贸易摩擦缓和是港股/A股最大宏观催化剂；若301关税框架7月底前落地，科技/消费板块有望迎来估值重估，直接利好多数持仓。

items.title: 四大证券报7/16头条：长鑫科技科创板IPO开申购（募资579-666亿），创新药授权上半年1100亿美元历史新高，央行加大逆周期调节
items.summary: 7月16日要闻：①长鑫科技（DRAM国产替代）科创板IPO开启，发行价8.66元，募资约579-666亿元；②上半年创新药对外授权交易总额约1100亿美元，创历史纪录；③央行副行长邹澜表态加大逆周期调节；④A股1692家公司中731家（43.2%）中报业绩预喜。
items.why: 长鑫科技IPO是A股半导体年度事件，与SK海力士/美光HBM主线共振；央行宽松+业绩预喜比例高，A股风险情绪偏多，间接支撑港股科技估值。
items.source: 中国证券报/上海证券报/证券时报/证券日报

items.title: 港股午盘(7/16)：恒指涨1.93%至25157，科技指数涨3.08%，小米快手各涨超6%
items.summary: 7月16日午盘，恒生指数涨1.93%报25157.56，恒生科技指数涨3.08%。小米、快手各涨超6%，美团、哔哩哔哩涨超5%，小鹏汽车涨超7%。黄金股走强，澜起科技跌超17%。
items.why: 港股科技/汽车全线拉升，持仓美团/小米今日走强；连续4日上涨累计逾2.6%，空头期权安全垫持续增厚。

items.title: Shein clears CSRC approval for Hong Kong IPO; HK market up 4 straight sessions
items.summary: Shein received approval from China's securities regulator (CSRC) to proceed with its planned Hong Kong IPO, clearing a key regulatory hurdle. The Hang Seng has gained 640+ points (+2.6%) over four consecutive sessions heading into the week.
items.why: Shein港股IPO将是近年来最大规模消费科技上市，对港股市场流动性与情绪有积极支撑；需关注其定价是否抽水影响其他持仓。

items.title: Tencent WeChat AI agent 'Xiaowei' in active beta; Q3 2026 public launch targeted — Bloomberg review
items.summary: Bloomberg reviewed Xiaowei, Tencent's native AI agent inside WeChat. It handles voice/text prompts, online search, Moments summarization, and mini-program tasks (flights, taxis, food orders). Uses WeLM + DeepSeek models. Tencent also launched Hy3 AI model July 6 and executed a HK$501M share buyback.
items.why: 微信AI智能体落地是腾讯最重要AI变现路径，支撑CICC HK$666目标价逻辑；今日小米/科技股整体大涨背景下，腾讯AI催化剂持续发酵；sell put仓位安全。

items.title: Citi forecasts Alibaba Cloud Q1 FY2027 revenue +45% YoY; AI revenue triple-digit growth for 11th straight quarter
items.summary: Citi raised its Alibaba Cloud revenue forecast to RMB 48.4B for the upcoming quarter, citing accelerating AI cloud adoption. Alibaba Cloud holds higher China AI cloud market share than the next three competitors combined. AI-related revenue has grown triple digits for 11 consecutive quarters.
items.why: 阿里云AI增速持续超预期，H200获批配额落实后将进一步加速；BABA估值重估核心驱动，对BABA期权多头策略（sell put或long call spread）具参考意义。

items.title: Tesla launches unsupervised Robotaxi in Miami — most challenging camera-only FSD test yet in tropical rain
items.summary: Tesla launched unsupervised Robotaxi service in Miami (western Miami-Dade) using camera-only FSD Model Y vehicles, its first market outside Texas/California. Miami's tropical downpours are the most challenging environment yet for camera-only FSD. ~59 vehicles previously operated across Austin, Dallas, Houston. Tesla Cybercab (no pedals/steering wheel) expected to join fleet late 2026.
items.why: Robotaxi迈阿密扩张是FSD商业化关键里程碑，热带降雨测试结果将影响市场对TSLA估值叙事的判断；对TSLA期权IV有直接影响，关注用户反馈与事故报告。

items.title: DigiTimes：HBM4价格预计2027年翻倍至4-5美元/GB，SK海力士CEO称2027年存储供应最短缺
items.summary: DigiTimes报告，受AI算力需求爆发和产能结构性瓶颈影响，HBM4价格预计2027年翻倍，从当前约2美元/GB升至4-5美元/GB。SK海力士CEO表示2027年将是存储芯片供应短缺最严重的一年，需求将持续超过产能直至2030年后。
items.why: HBM4涨价预期强化了美光/SK海力士/闪迪长期多头逻辑；对美光（MU）和闪迪（SNDK）持仓额外增加估值支撑，期权策略可考虑拉长到期日。

items.title: SanDisk retests $1,500 support on NAND competition fears; Goldman Sachs raises target to $2,200
items.summary: SanDisk (SNDK) fell below $1,500 on July 15 amid fears of NAND pricing weakness, rising YMTC competition, and capacity expansion margin pressure. The stock surged ~800% in H1 2026. Goldman Sachs raised its price target to $2,200 from $1,200 (Buy), citing enterprise SSD demand and tighter supply.
items.why: 闪迪$1500支撑位测试是近期关键技术节点；高盛目标价$2200显示40%+上行空间，但800%的H1涨幅带来高波动风险；关注NAND现货价格走向以决定期权策略方向。

items.title: 携程遭监管双重夹击：网信办罚款千万（数据出境），反垄断调查已满五个月；Citi目标价下调至$64
items.summary: 2026年6月，上海市网信办对携程开出千万元罚单（数据出境违规），反垄断调查持续进行已满五个月，涉及数据合规、反垄断、算法治理、票务规范四条监管线。Citi将TCOM目标价从$82下调至$64，Barclays调至$60，Q2增速指引仅3%-8%。
items.why: 携程监管压力多线汇聚+增速指引偏低，短期不确定性显著；对TCOM期权策略需适当提高sell put行权价安全距离，避免监管重锤导致踩踏。

items.title: 老铺黄金一年股价暴跌64%，市值蒸发约1200亿港元；高库存+金价回调+竞争加剧三重压力
items.summary: 老铺黄金从2025年7月高点1065港元跌至约380港元，市值蒸发约1200亿港元。存货从40.88亿元飙升至160.4亿元，公司在高位大举囤金。周大福古法金系列上半年销售额34亿港元（+48%）竞争加剧。近期特别股息已于7月8日派发。
items.why: 老铺黄金金价敞口过大，若金价继续调整将持续承压；竞争加剧削弱护城河，需重新评估金价走势支撑仓位逻辑；特别股息是近期唯一正面事件。

items.title: 拼多多2025年净利润首次同比下降12%，Temu受de minimis取消重挫；2026年GMV目标1300亿美元
items.summary: 拼多多2025年净利润首次下降（同比约-12%），主因Temu在美国de minimis豁免取消后物流成本飙升，欧盟7月起取消150欧元免税带来新一轮压力。2026年GMV目标1300亿美元（+50%）。PDD另创设新品牌部门「新拼木」，首期投资150亿元，三年规划1000亿元。
items.why: 拼多多净利下降打破持续增长神话；Temu成本结构挑战持续，对PDD期权策略需保守对待下行风险，同时新拼木品牌战略是否能打开新增长空间值得持续跟踪。

items.title: 港股创新药/CXO板块全线爆发，成7月15日盘面新热点，接棒科技汽车
items.summary: 7月15日港股，恒生指数与国企指数均涨超1%。创新药、CXO（合同研究）板块强势领涨，成为市场新主线热点，君实生物涨超10%引领板块。
items.why: 港股医药板块资金轮动显现，若行情持续则科技+医药双轮驱动形成；关注创新药龙头IV走高对现有put策略的影响。

items.title: Apple Intelligence approved for launch in China with Alibaba's Qwen AI
items.summary: China's CAC approved Apple Intelligence for Chinese users powered by Alibaba's Qwen AI, covering iOS/iPadOS/macOS/visionOS. BABA surged ~5-6% in pre-market on the news.
items.why: Apple与阿里云通义千问深度绑定，利好阿里云AI商业化，同时提振iPhone在华需求；BABA单日+7.65%，持仓影响显著。

items.title: TSMC Reports 36% Sales Growth as AI Demand Stays Strong
items.summary: TSMC Q2 2026 revenue $39.62B (+36% YoY), with AI chips now comprising 61% of total sales, validating sustained demand for Nvidia Blackwell/Rubin platforms.
items.why: 台积电Q2强劲确认AI芯片超级周期，英伟达Vera Rubin产能排期无忧，利好整条AI供应链及相关持仓标的期权溢价。

items.title: ASML raises 2026 guidance second time, beats Q2 earnings on AI chip demand
items.summary: ASML Q2 2026 net sales EUR 9.3B (beat consensus); full-year 2026 guidance raised for the second time to EUR 43-45B (from EUR 36-40B), driven by AI-related demand for advanced logic and memory equipment.
items.why: ASML二度上调指引意味着台积电/SK海力士HBM产能扩张超预期，是半导体设备最强领先指标，利好存储和AI芯片整条链。

items.title: Alibaba (BABA) Stock Forecast July 2026: Four Catalysts Drove 12% in Two Days
items.summary: BABA surged 12% over two days on four catalysts: $600M DOJ settlement, Pentagon procurement reprieve, narrowing instant-commerce losses, and access to Nvidia H200 chips. Alibaba Cloud grew 38% YoY in Q4 FY2026, with AI products at 30% of external cloud revenue.
items.why: 法律及监管双重压制解除，AI云基本面持续兑现，BABA估值重估逻辑明确，亦利好阿里云期权链隐含波动率。

items.title: Tesla scores best-ever Q2: 480,126 deliveries (+25% YoY), earnings call July 22
items.summary: Tesla Q2 2026 deliveries: 480,126 vehicles (+25% YoY, beating Wall Street by 74,000) and 13.5 GWh energy storage deployed (+53% QoQ). Q2 financial results call confirmed for July 22 at 5:30PM ET.
items.why: Q2大幅超预期确立交付反弹趋势，储能业务同步爆发；7月22日财报催化剂在即，TSLA期权隐含波动率料将抬升。

items.title: 腾讯秘密开发微信AI智能体，拟三季度全量上线
items.summary: 腾讯正为微信秘密研发AI智能体（代号Xiaowei），计划Q3 2026向14亿月活用户全量推出，用户可通过语音/文字调用小程序完成支付、订餐等任务；上线节奏取决于监管审批。
items.why: 微信AI智能体是腾讯下半年最重要催化剂，覆盖14亿用户，有望驱动广告、支付、腾讯云三大业务再上台阶；大摩已将此列为核心超配逻辑。

items.title: China's GDP expands 4.7% in H1 2026; H2 counter-cyclical stimulus step-up signaled
items.summary: China NBS: H1 2026 GDP +4.7% YoY (Q1 +5.0%, Q2 +4.3%), foreign trade +16.9%, urban unemployment 5.0%. Officials pledged to deploy incremental stimulus measures at the right moment in H2.
items.why: Q2增速放缓至4.3%，下半年政策加码信号明确，利好港股/A股消费与科技赛道估值修复，与持仓标的高度契合。

items.title: A July rate hike from the Fed? The odds are rising to 46.5%
items.summary: CME FedWatch shows 46.5% probability of a 25bp hike at the July 29 FOMC meeting (up from ~25%), as US CPI stands at 4.2% YoY. Fed Chair Warsh is pushing a data-dependent, forward-guidance-light approach.
items.why: 加息概率升至近50%将抬升期权隐含波动率，对sell put策略的行权价设置和到期日选择有直接含义；成长股估值承压。

items.title: GENIUS Act countdown: Stablecoin rules deadline July 18 — six US federal agencies on the clock
items.summary: Six US federal agencies face a July 18 statutory deadline to finalize GENIUS Act stablecoin rules. USDC already substantially meets compliance requirements; Circle expected to be the first issuer to receive formal PPSI designation.
items.why: 后天（7月18日）是USDC合规化关键时间节点，规则落地将为机构采用扫清障碍，是CRCL股价近期最重要催化剂。

items.title: U.S.-Iran escalation weighs on bitcoin, stocks as oil climbs
items.summary: Bitcoin fell to ~$62,600 as US-Iran tensions drove risk-off moves and lifted oil prices. Bitcoin ETF outflows exceeded $84M in recent sessions; BTC tests support under $63K ahead of July 29 FOMC.
items.why: 地缘风险叠加Fed鹰派，BTC承压，Circle(USDC)及加密相关标的情绪短期受压；油价上涨可能加剧通胀，进一步支持加息预期。

items.title: Palantir (PLTR) +24% in July on Nvidia sovereign AI partnership; consensus Buy at $187
items.summary: Palantir shares surged ~24% in July to $133.75, driven by an expanded Nvidia partnership deploying Nemotron AI models in classified, air-gapped US government environments via AIP/Foundry/Apollo. Q1 2026 revenue $1.633B (+85% YoY); consensus Buy, avg target $187.42.
items.why: 国防AI合同壁垒高、波动率特征稳定，PLTR是sell put策略优质标的；与英伟达协同将进一步拓宽政府合同护城河。

items.title: 我国经济半年报出炉：新质生产力表现亮眼，下半年政策调节力度或将加码
items.summary: 中国上半年新质生产力（高端制造、数字经济）贡献超40%增量，政策层面确认下半年将适时加码逆周期政策，重点支持科技创新与消费升级。
items.why: 政策加码信号利好港股/A股消费与科技双赛道，与持仓的腾讯、阿里、泡泡玛特等核心标的高度契合。

items.title: Tesla expands Robotaxi service to Miami — first city outside Texas
items.summary: Tesla rolled out its unsupervised Cybercab robotaxi service in a geofenced area of West Miami on July 14, the first expansion beyond Texas. Florida's rain is a key stress test for Tesla's camera-only FSD system.
items.why: Robotaxi跨州扩张标志FSD商业化加速，是TSLA从汽车公司向AI出行平台重估的关键里程碑；7月22日财报前持续催化。

items.title: Google delays Gemini 3.5 Pro to July 17 after full rebuild; DeepMind talent exodus deepens
items.summary: Google DeepMind rebuilt Gemini 3.5 Pro from scratch on a Gemini 3 foundation targeting July 17 launch with a 2M-token context window, after structural failures were found in the 2.5 Pro architecture. Alphabet lost ~$225B in market cap amid four senior DeepMind departures.
items.why: Gemini 3.5 Pro明日（7月17日）即将发布，若表现强劲将提振谷歌搜索广告护城河；DeepMind人才流失是中长期估值风险点。

items.title: Micron Q3 FY2026: Revenue +346% YoY, HBM4 in production for Nvidia Vera Rubin; 2026 capacity sold out
items.summary: Micron Q3 FY2026 revenue $41.456B (+346% YoY); HBM4 entered production and is shipping to Nvidia for Vera Rubin platform; all 2026 HBM capacity is sold out. Stock near $989-995; analyst consensus target $1,486.
items.why: 全年HBM产能售罄锁定业绩确定性，HBM4为英伟达Rubin供货确认存储超级周期；MU是sell put的优质高溢价标的。

items.title: SanDisk (SNDK) drops 5.71%: Argus 'Hold' rating, NAND competition fears; bulls target $3,000 year-end
items.summary: SanDisk fell 5.71% on July 15 after Argus Research started with a 'Hold' (not Buy); NAND prices declining faster than expected amid Chinese competition. Motley Fool argues BiCS10 tech leads peers by 59% density plus Meta multi-year supply deal supports a $3,000 year-end target.
items.why: SNDK年内涨逾800%后多空激烈博弈，NAND价格走势是卖put安全边际的核心变量；8月5日财报是关键看清节点。

items.title: 盈透证券新增12种加密代币交易；6月DARTs同比+53%创历史新高
items.summary: 盈透证券（IBKR）7月14日新增12种加密代币（含Aave、Aptos、Uniswap等）及稳定币出金功能；2026年6月DARTs达526.9万笔（+53% YoY，+6% MoM），客户权益与保证金余额双创纪录；Q2财报定于7月21日收市后发布。
items.why: 加密业务扩展+DARTs历史新高显示业务势头强劲，7月21日财报催化剂临近；H1股价+35.3%后财报超预期概率高，期权布局值得关注。

items.title: SK Hynix (SKHY) surges 27% then consolidates; Barclays initiates Outperform at $330; HBM4 ships for Nvidia Vera Rubin
items.summary: SK Hynix Korean shares jumped ~13.4% on July 15; US ADR SKHY hit $193 after surging 27% on July 14, then consolidated at ~$186. Barclays initiated with Outperform/$330 target. DRAM supply meets only 75-80% of demand; HBM4 now shipping for Nvidia Vera Rubin.
items.why: HBM4量产超预期，供应缺口结构性存在，巴克莱$330目标价隐含大幅上涨空间；SKHY ADR是卖put高溢价优质标的。

items.title: Xiaomi delivers 30,000+ EVs in July (record); YU7 waitlist extends to H2 2026; new SU7 to launch this month
items.summary: Xiaomi EV deliveries surpassed 30,000 in July for the first time (new monthly record). YU7 SUV demand far exceeds capacity with new orders stretching into H2. CEO Lei Jun announced a new-generation SU7 will be officially released this month with large-scale deliveries to follow.
items.why: 产能与交付双超预期，YU7订单积压转为确定性收入，新SU7本月发布将是1810.HK股价催化剂，可考虑财报前期权布局。

items.title: Intel (INTC): 18A-P enters risk production, $100 support holds ahead of July 23 earnings
items.summary: Intel's 18A-P process (9% performance improvement over base 18A, yield improved from 65% to 85%) entered risk production in June. Stock held ~$100 support on July 15. Q2 earnings due July 23; Gaudi 3 enterprise adoption still lags Nvidia.
items.why: 7月23日财报是18A代工业务信用重建的关键节点，若Gaudi 3获突破性采购将是重大超预期事件；当前$100支撑是关键风险观察点。

items.title: TAL Education to release Q1 FY2027 financial results on July 30
items.summary: TAL Education Group will report Q1 FY2027 results (period ended May 31, 2026) before US market open on July 30. Prior quarter net profit grew 174% YoY; AI courseware and smart learning devices are scaling, with offline learning center openings up 60% YoY.
items.why: 7月30日财报倒计时，上季净利润+174%设定高期望基数，AI教育硬件加速商业化；财报前可评估期权策略。

items.title: Costco June net sales +10.6% YoY to $29.24B; declares $1.47 quarterly dividend
items.summary: Costco June 2026 (five weeks ended July 5): net sales $29.24B (+10.6% YoY); comparable sales +8.8%; digitally-enabled sales +20.9%. Board declared $1.47/share quarterly dividend payable August 7. Stock fell ~1.2% AH as comps decelerated from May's +12.5%.
items.why: 可比店销售增速较5月下滑引发消费降速担忧，但会员制基本面稳健；派息信号盈利信心足，COST短期期权隐含波动率偏低适合卖put。

items.title: Asian Stocks Bounce on Wall Street Inflation Relief but China Stumbles — KOSPI Surges 7.1%, SK Hynix +9.4%
items.summary: July 15: South Korea's KOSPI led Asian gains at +7.1% (7,343), with SK Hynix +9.4% and Samsung +6.1% on memory sector rebound. Japan Nikkei +0.9% to 68,354. China Shanghai Composite edged down 0.4% as Q2 GDP disappointed at 4.3%. Hong Kong Hang Seng +1.4%, led by tech. Regional rally driven by softer US June CPI released overnight.
items.why: 亚太多市场联动上涨，SK海力士美股SKHY+日韩联动验证HBM主题持续；中国A股疲软可能令相关对冲仓位Beta分化，需关注下半年政策刺激节奏以决定是否加仓A股期权。

items.title: China Q2 GDP growth slows to 4.3%, H1 at 4.7% — weakest quarterly pace in over 3 years
items.summary: National Bureau of Statistics released July 15: Q2 GDP +4.3% YoY (vs 4.5% consensus), Q1 was +5.0%. H1 total 69.57 trillion yuan, +4.7% YoY. Real estate investment fell 18%; new growth drivers (AI, advanced manufacturing) contributed >40% of growth. Officials attribute slowdown to external shocks and pledge additional H2 policy support.
items.why: Q2增速低于目标区间下限，政策加码预期升温；对科技/消费持仓影响偏正（刺激预期），但宏观疲软压制周期板块。期权层面，沪深300波动率或因政策博弈短期走宽。

items.title: 港股收评：恒指涨1.4%，科指涨1.3%；美团涨超5%，腾讯涨超3%，MINIMAX涨超13%；生物医药强势
items.summary: 7月15日港股收盘：恒生指数涨1.4%报24681点，恒生科技指数涨1.3%，国企指数涨1%。科网股全线上行，美团+5%、联想+3%、腾讯+3%；AI应用股MINIMAX单日涨超13%；药明合联+7%，中金公司+5%。国家卫健委发布2026版国家基本药物目录（9月1日起施行）。
items.why: 美团、腾讯均为持仓核心标的，当日大幅走高直接利好组合净值；若短期维持强势需警惕covered call行权压力，2026版药物目录对生物医药细分赛道构成催化。

items.title: US CPI Falls for First Time Since 2020 in June; Core Gauge Unchanged — Fed July Hike Door Slams Shut
items.summary: Bloomberg, July 14: June headline CPI fell 0.4% MoM (first monthly drop since 2020), pulling annual rate to 3.5%. Core CPI flat at 0% MoM, YoY 2.6% — coolest print since 2021. S&P 500 +0.38% to 7,543; Nasdaq +0.9% to 26,107; semiconductor ETF SMH +2.5%. Gasoline and shelter cost declines drove the beat.
items.why: CPI超预期降温，7月加息概率从42%骤降至17%，风险资产全线反弹；对持有美股科技/芯片仓位明显利好。Sell put策略受益于方向性支撑，但隐含波动率可能同步收缩。

items.title: ByteDance and Alibaba disable humanlike AI custom agents today as China's new AI companion rules take effect
items.summary: SCMP: ByteDance's Doubao and Alibaba's Qwen shut down user-created AI agent features on July 15, coinciding with enforcement of China's Interim Measures for Anthropomorphic AI Interaction Services. Rules mandate anti-addiction systems, under-14 identity checks and always-available exit options. User agent data permanently deleted. Platforms had months to prepare; both companies confirmed permanent shutdown with no migration path.
items.why: 阿里Qwen智能体功能强制下线，合规成本上升但BABA/9988股价影响有限；监管边界扩大意味着整个AI应用赛道面临合规不确定性，可关注监管催化期权隐波上行机会。

items.title: 中东局势重燃油价上行担忧：美伊紧张升级，特朗普称担任霍尔木兹「守护者」；WTI或破$90
items.summary: 7月13日特朗普宣称美国将成霍尔木兹海峡「守护者」并拟对过境船只收取20%通行费，美伊军事对抗继续。WTI原油近期在$73附近徘徊，金联创分析师警示：若局势持续，油价潜在上目标$90以上。OPEC将2026年需求增长预测下调至78万桶/日，IEA预计因战争影响全球消费减少100万桶/日。
items.why: 油价上行对通胀预期构成边际压力，或重燃美联储加息预期，利空高估值成长持仓；老铺黄金等避险资产受益，需动态评估地缘风险对期权隐含波动率的推高效应。

items.title: Nvidia NVDA tests $212 as AI demand surges; US confirms limited H200 GPU exports to China under BIS license
items.summary: FX Leaders, July 15: NVDA approaches $212 technical resistance with market cap >$5.1T. US officials confirmed first H200 GPU shipments to China under BIS license (capped at 50% of US domestic volume). Next-gen Kyber server cabinet delayed to 2028 due to circuit board manufacturing failures. DOJ/FTC expanding antitrust probe of CUDA hardware lock-in.
items.why: 英伟达股价持续创历史新高，AI芯片需求旺盛；中国H200出口受限但已开闸，为中国AI产业链提供边际利好；Kyber延期2028影响数据中心升级节奏。$200附近sell put收益依然可观。

items.title: Cooler US CPI Slams Door on July Fed Hike: Rate Hike Odds Fall to 17% from 42%; Next FOMC July 28-29
items.summary: Benzinga, July 14: CME FedWatch July hike odds fell to 17% (vs 42% pre-CPI). Fed funds rate holds at 3.50-3.75%. Minutes from June meeting signaled no cuts until early 2027. Market now prices Fed on hold through year-end unless inflation re-accelerates (Middle East oil risks key wildcard). Next FOMC meeting July 28-29 under Chair Kevin Warsh.
items.why: 加息概率骤降减少估值折现压力，利好科技/消费组合；中东油价风险是逆转因子，若7月FOMC发出鹰派信号可能重创高倍数仓位。建议7月下旬前后关注短期波动率交易机会。

items.title: SK Hynix soars 13% in Nasdaq debut (SKHY), closes at $168 — $26.5B IPO second-largest US listing ever
items.summary: Fast Company: SK Hynix regular-way trading began July 13 under SKHY. Stock closed at $168.01 (+12.8% vs $149 IPO price) in first session, on $26.5B raised — second-largest US IPO ever. SK Hynix holds ~60% HBM market share. In Seoul on July 15, KOSPI surged 7.1% with SK Hynix jumping 9.4%. Company slowing HBM4 ramp to prioritize DDR5 margin optimization.
items.why: SK海力士美股SKHY上市首日大涨，HBM赛道估值中枢上移；南向两倍做多产品受益，隐含波动率可能随新股流动性建立而逐步正常化。HBM4E样品已送主要客户，下一轮业绩催化可期。

items.title: A股7月15日开盘：半导体、存储芯片、先进封装领涨；超2900股飘绿；智谱涨超6%
items.summary: 7月15日A股开盘分化：沪指低开0.09%，深证成指+0.31%，创业板+0.74%，科创综指+0.81%。半导体、存储芯片、先进封装、电子布、培育钻石涨幅居前；油气开采、航天军工、煤炭领跌。AI应用方向智谱相关涨超6%；超2900只个股飘绿，市场分化明显，沪指今日已涨至约3967点区域。
items.why: A股科技/半导体板块与港美联动，但大盘整体分化说明资金选择性强；消费赛道表现平淡，建议重点关注港股科技标的跨市场溢价及A股存储芯片相关个股期权机会。

items.title: Intel INTC jumps 4.5% on July 15 as AI chip demand lifts tech sector; 18A yields tracking ahead of schedule
items.summary: FX Leaders, July 15: INTC rises 4.5% in session, outperforming broader tech. Company reports 18A process yields running ahead of internal projections; 14A also tracking ahead of 18A at comparable stage. External foundry customers (Microsoft, AWS) design commitments expected late 2026/early 2027. Q1 2026 IFS operating loss ~$2.4B; headcount cut to 75,000. HSBC raised target to $200.
items.why: 英特尔代工业务转好信号出现，若18A良率持续改善可能逐步争回AI芯片市场份额；但巨额亏损意味着短期基本面压力较大，sell put需注意财报日（7月下旬）波动风险。

items.title: Shein wins CSRC approval for Hong Kong IPO targeting up to $3B raise at $40-50B valuation by August
items.summary: Shein Global Holdings received CSRC approval on July 10 to list on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, planning to issue up to 341.6M shares and raise $2-3B at an estimated $40-50B valuation, with listing as early as August 2026.
items.why: Shein港股IPO将是近年最大IPO之一，利好港股整体情绪；需关注申购窗口及上市首日流通影响。

items.title: 韩国KOSPI年内第7次熔断，SK海力士单日暴跌15.4%创史上最大跌幅
items.summary: 7月13日，韩国KOSPI暴跌逾8%触发年内第7次熔断，SK海力士单日下跌15.4%刷新历史最大单日跌幅，市值蒸发约1400亿美元；外资净卖出1.7万亿韩元。导火索为Q2利润预期低于市场共识约8%，叠加美伊地缘紧张。
items.why: 半导体板块全球联动，港股AI/存储芯片ETF短期受压；HBM长约定价模式揭示AI内存股整体估值风险，需关注英伟达供应链传导。

items.title: US June CPI cools to 3.9%; five major banks Q2 earnings all beat — S&P 500 closes higher
items.summary: US June CPI fell from 4.2% to 3.9% YoY as gasoline prices slid ~10%; core CPI held at 2.9%. JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, BofA, Wells Fargo and Citi all beat Q2 EPS estimates — the sector's eighth consecutive quarterly beat. US equities rallied on the double positive.
items.why: CPI降温叠加银行财报全线超预期，risk-on情绪升温；对sell put策略有利，隐含波动率可能因利好落地压缩。但美联储鹰派立场未变，需警惕短期反弹高度。

items.title: China June exports surge 27% YoY to record $412B; Q2 GDP 4.3% misses 4.5% target
items.summary: China's June exports hit an all-time high of $412.4B (+27% YoY) driven by AI hardware demand, generating a record $125.6B trade surplus. Q2 2026 GDP came in at 4.3%, below the 4.5% consensus and the lower end of Beijing's 2026 target range.
items.why: 出口超强但内需仍弱；AI硬件出口拉动科技链，内需消费股受GDP不及预期拖累；港股短期分化，科技板块强、消费弱。

items.title: 阿里巴巴与美国司法部达成6亿美元不起诉协议，含3.25亿美元罚款
items.summary: 阿里巴巴及其美国支付子公司与DOJ达成不起诉协议，共支付约6亿美元含3.25亿美元罚款并加强合规；联邦法院同时给予阿里美国游说活动临时豁免。BABA股价7月8日前后升至$112附近。
items.why: 法律不确定性大幅出清，有利于BABA估值修复；隐含波动率可能因监管利空消除而压缩，适合观察sell put入场时机。

items.title: SK海力士Q2利润预期低于市场共识8%，HBM长约定价拖累ASP错失现货涨价红利
items.summary: KIS证券预测SK海力士Q2运营利润约60.4万亿韩元，同比+556%但低于市场预期65万亿韩元约8%；核心原因是HBM采用长期供货协议定价，错失DRAM现货季环比+30%、NAND+50%涨价红利，ASP增速受限。
items.why: HBM长约定价困境是本轮半导体估值重评核心逻辑；若美光也存在类似长约比例，同样逻辑适用；AI存储芯片持仓面临估值修正压力，但长约提供业绩确定性。

items.title: 小米发布澎程SkyNomad全新SUV系列，4个交易日股价涨逾10%
items.summary: 雷军宣布小米澎程SkyNomad系列定位智能可变大空间SUV，与SU7/YU7形成差异化矩阵；YU7 7月综合权益优惠最高7.9万元至7月31日。1810.HK自7月8日公告后4个交易日累计涨幅超10%。
items.why: 汽车新品线延伸验证小米电车战略持续推进；股价强势意味着covered call行权风险提升，sell put可考虑等回调机会入场。

items.title: PDD Holdings Q1 EPS missed by 43% at 9.51 RMB vs 16.77 est; Temu faces de minimis headwinds
items.summary: PDD reported Q1 EPS of 9.51 RMB vs consensus 16.77 RMB (-43.3%) and revenue of 106.2B RMB (+11% YoY). Net income fell 15% due to strategic investments. U.S. de minimis exemption removal eroded Temu's pricing advantage. PDD shares down ~26% YTD at ~$85.
items.why: 拼多多Q1利润大幅低预期反映国内竞争加剧与Temu关税冲击双重压力；Citi视为互联网首选股但基本面短期压力仍在；期权方面需评估IV是否已充分定价下行风险。

items.title: 段永平再度增持泡泡玛特，持股比例从6.85%升至7.65%
items.summary: 知名投资人段永平7月初再度增持泡泡玛特（09992.HK），持股从6.85%升至7.65%，累计持有约1.02亿股。
items.why: 价值型大投资者在股价腰斩后持续加仓，是潜在的估值底部信号；对泡泡玛特相关期权策略可参考此信号评估风险收益比。

items.title: TAL Education to release Q1 FY2027 results July 30; MathGPT AI Learning showcased at World AI Conference
items.summary: TAL Education Group (TAL) will release Q1 FY2027 (March-May 2026) results on July 30 before market open. The MathGPT AI Learning platform debuted at the 2026 World AI Conference in Shanghai demonstrating AI-powered virtual one-on-one tutoring.
items.why: 好未来7月30日财报是关键事件；MathGPT能否转化为业绩增量是核心观察点；财报前需评估期权IV变化以决策是否过报持仓。

items.title: 携程Q1营收同比增17.2%超预期，Q2指引增速放缓至3-8%
items.summary: 携程集团（9961.HK/TCOM）Q1营收162.08亿元同比+17.19%，Non-GAAP净利润39.05亿元同比-6.76%，均超Bloomberg一致预期。Q2指引净营收增速3-8%，主因交通票务负增长及酒店收入增速放缓。
items.why: 携程Q2指引保守但Q1基础扎实；出行消费韧性支撑中期，交通票务负增长是结构性压力点；期权策略方面，保守指引意味着短期股价承压。

items.title: Walmart announces sweeping Rollback price cuts; channel checks suggest slowing same-store sales
items.summary: Walmart (WMT) launched nationwide Rollback price cuts across grocery, household essentials, outdoor, toys, and apparel. Cleveland Research channel checks suggest same-store sales are slowing with potential excess inventory being cleared. WMT shares down ~20% from May highs.
items.why: 沃尔玛降价反映零售端库存压力与消费信心走弱；股价已回调20%，但同店销售放缓信号需Q2财报官方确认；对消费类期权策略提供参考基准。

items.title: 美团开源LongCat-2.0大模型，巩固本地生活AI竞争壁垒
items.summary: 美团（03690.HK）正式开源LongCat-2.0大模型，分析师认为此举将强化美团在本地生活服务市场的AI领导地位。
items.why: AI能力开源有助于生态扩张与技术形象提升，与美团中长期基本面正面相关，强化赛道竞争壁垒叙事。

items.title: US-Iran Ceasefire Collapses; Brent Crude Surges to ~$85, WTI at $79.56—Risk-Off Hits Asia
items.summary: President Trump reversed his offer to lift a 20% Strait of Hormuz protection fee, reigniting US-Iran tensions. Brent crude rose ~2% to $84.95/barrel and WTI gained 1.82% to $79.56. The renewed conflict, which first erupted on Feb. 28 with US-Israeli airstrikes, weighed heavily on Hong Kong equities (HSI -1%) and inflation expectations.
items.why: 地缘风险重燃是本轮港股回调主因（恒指跌1%），同时推升油价进一步加大CPI回落的不确定性；高油价对能源敏感型消费股（餐饮/出行）形成成本压力，对持有科技消费股的策略需关注宏观通胀路径变化。

items.title: IBM Shares Plunge 25%—Worst Day on Record—After Q2 Revenue Miss; Enterprise Software Stocks Rattled
items.summary: IBM pre-announced Q2 2026 revenue of $17.2B (vs. $17.86B estimate), with infrastructure revenue -7% as clients shifted capex to servers, storage, and memory ahead of supply-constrained price rises. The 25% single-day decline exceeded IBM's previous record crash on Black Monday 1987.
items.why: IBM暴跌25%是本周最重要宏观信号：大企业将季末预算转向AI基础设施抢货（存储/服务器/内存），软件预算被挤压。对持仓的含义：利好SK海力士、美光、英伟达等存储/AI芯片；软件类ETF与相关持仓须关注连锁影响，同时也显示AI硬件需求极度旺盛。

items.title: U.S. June CPI Fell 0.4% MoM; Headline YoY 3.5%, Core 2.6%—Below All Forecasts
items.summary: The BLS reported June CPI -0.4% MoM, putting the YoY rate at 3.5% (vs. forecast 3.8%, May's 4.2%). Core CPI was flat on the month, with 12-month core at 2.6%. The S&P 500 rose 0.38% and the Nasdaq gained 0.9% on the print, led by semiconductor stocks.
items.why: 通胀大幅低于预期，CPI六月份大跌0.4%，核心通胀12个月仅2.6%——主因油价回落；但美联储7月会议仍预期按兵不动（FedWatch 85.6%持稳）。纳指反弹利好科技持仓，短期Sell Put窗口略微改善，但需警惕油价反弹重推通胀。

items.title: 6月中国出口同比+27%创历史新高至4124亿美元，贸易顺差1256亿美元史上第二高
items.summary: 中国6月出口同比增长27%至4124亿美元，大幅超市场预期的18.2%，刷新历史最高纪录；进口同比+36%；贸易顺差1256亿美元创史上第二高。AI相关硬件（半导体为最大单项，占出口约10%）是最主要驱动力，同时出口商赶在关税进一步落地前抢出货。
items.why: 出口爆增提振A股情绪（沪指+1.36%，深成+2.77%），AI硬件出口激增间接验证国内AI产业链景气；同时强出口支撑Q2 GDP预期（明日公布），对科技/消费持仓整体利好。

items.title: Fed Funds Rate Steady at 3.50–3.75%; July 28-29 FOMC Expected to Hold Despite Below-Forecast CPI
items.summary: The Fed funds rate remains at 3.50–3.75% after June's softer-than-expected CPI. CME FedWatch shows 85.6% probability of no change at the July 28-29 meeting, up from 58.3% before the print. However, markets price ~42% chance of at least one 25bp hike by year-end given renewed oil pressures.
items.why: 7月按兵不动概率大，但年内仍有42%概率加息——这一路径主要取决于油价走势。对Sell Put策略：高利率+高IV环境中期权premium维持高位，是相对有利条件；但需警惕年末加息导致指数二次回调。

items.title: Alibaba Settles $600M DOJ Non-Prosecution Deal Over Illegal Drug Sales; BABA Jumped ~12%
items.summary: Alibaba and its U.S. payment arm AUS Merchant Services agreed to a $600M non-prosecution settlement with the DOJ over allegations of facilitating ~80,000 illegal pharmaceutical sales (2016–2024). The stock surged ~12% on July 2 as the settlement cleared a major legal overhang. Analysts at Daiwa and Nomura trimmed price targets but maintained Buy ratings.
items.why: 最大法律风险出清，BABA估值重估空间打开；同时通义千问Qwen活跃用户持续增长，阿里云AI营收提速，与Eli Lilly合作进入GLP-1医疗场景。Sell Put行权价下行风险已大幅收窄，关注后续季报（8月前后）进一步验证云业务反转。

items.title: Tesla Miami Robotaxi Live as of July 3; First User Impressions Documented July 14 Ahead of Q2 Earnings
items.summary: Tesla's driverless Robotaxi service launched in Miami (10–14 sq. miles in western Miami-Dade) on July 3, 2026—making Miami the second city after Texas. FSD v14 Lite began rolling out to HW3 vehicles. Q2 2026 deliveries were ~480,000 vehicles and 13.5 GWh of energy storage. Full Q2 earnings call is July 22.
items.why: Robotaxi扩至迈阿密兑现商业化叙事，Q2交付、储能均创纪录；7月22日财报是近期重要期权窗口——可考虑在财报前后管理Sell Put或Covered Call头寸以应对可能的大波动。若财报超预期，隐含波动率在事件后通常回落，出售高位IV的Put有较好胜率。

items.title: GENIUS Act Stablecoin Compliance Deadline Falls July 18; Circle Faces Key Test on CRCL Volatility Risk
items.summary: The GENIUS Act's one-year transition period (signed July 18, 2025) expires July 18, 2026, requiring stablecoin issuers to comply with new federal reserve management, licensing, and supervision standards. Analysts flag elevated CRCL stock volatility risk around the deadline as market assesses Circle's compliance posture and competitive position.
items.why: 7月18日是本周最重要的监管节点：GENIUS Act全面生效将定义USDC合规框架。若过渡顺利，为CRCL提供长期确定性支撑；若细则加重发行方负担（如与银行联合发行限制），可能压制估值。Sell Put策略在此前后需控制仓位或选择行权价更低的安全垫。

items.title: Micron Issues Record FY2026 Q3 Guidance: ~$33.5B Revenue, 81% Gross Margin; HBM Sold Out Through 2026
items.summary: Micron (MU) guided fiscal Q3 FY2026 revenue of approximately $33.5B with 81% gross margin and >$19 EPS, well above prior estimates. All HBM supply is fully allocated through 2026, with structural constraints expected to persist into 2027. The company has crossed the $1T market cap milestone.
items.why: 美光HBM全年售罄+创纪录毛利验证AI存储超级周期；IBM事件（客户季末抢购内存/存储）是同一逻辑的直接体现。对做多美光（MU）及两倍做多产品头寸：中线逻辑强化，持仓方向明确，但$1T市值后估值扩张空间已部分定价，Sell Put行权价可对应当前强劲基本面上调保护位。

items.title: Hang Seng Index Falls Over 1% to ~23,970 as Iran Tensions and Weak US Futures Dampen Sentiment
items.summary: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index dropped more than 1% (approximately 240 points) to around 23,970 on July 15, as renewed US-Iran hostilities and sliding Wall Street futures weighed on risk appetite. Investors were also cautious ahead of China's Q2 GDP data due July 16.
items.why: 港股大盘跌逾1%，恒指年内仍在两万三左右震荡；卖出期权（Sell Put）持仓须注意隐含波动率是否上升以及行权价安全边际，同时留意7月16日中国Q2 GDP数据对市场情绪的提振或拖累。

items.title: A股强势反弹：沪指涨1.36%报3967点，深成涨2.77%，科技板块领涨
items.summary: 受6月出口数据超预期提振，A股7月15日大幅反弹，上证综指涨1.36%收报3967.1点（此前曾触三个月低位），深证成指涨2.77%至14924.9点。科技股（光模块、半导体设备）、铝、钼、黄金矿等板块领涨。
items.why: A股从前日低点显著反弹，出口数据超预期为核心催化；科技/金属主题个股走强；明日Q2 GDP数据（预期4.6-4.9%）是下一个重要验证节点，若低于预期可能再度引发情绪回落。

items.title: 美股7月13日三大指数全线收跌：纳指跌1.55%至25,873，存储股重挫，闪迪/美光各跌约6%
items.summary: S&P 500跌0.79%至7,515.34，纳斯达克跌1.55%至25,873.18，道指跌138点(-0.26%)至52,498.64。存储芯片类股领跌：Roundhill内存ETF(DRAM)跌9%，闪迪/美光/西数各跌约5-6%；英伟达涨约4%、Meta涨约6%部分对冲跌势。
items.why: 美股整体回调由韩国半导体崩盘蔓延，存储股集中暴跌对MU/SNDK持仓影响重大；期权卖方需评估组合delta暴露。

items.title: 段永平增持泡泡玛特至7.65%，斥资15.89亿港元，成第二大股东；股价7月13日涨3.52%
items.summary: 段永平通过港交所披露（交易日7月6日）增购1059万股（每股上限150港元，合计约15.89亿港元），持股从6.85%升至7.65%，持股超1亿股，晋升为仅次于创始人王宁的第二大股东。他表示「不在意短期波动，只看未来20年」。消息推动股价7月13日涨3.52%至156港元。
items.why: 知名长线投资人大手笔增持是重要信心信号；约150港元行权价附近可作sell put参考支撑位，但需注意Labubu销量放缓的基本面隐患。
items.source: 财联社 / 东方财富 / 界面新闻

items.title: 特朗普宣布封锁霍尔木兹海峡，布伦特原油单日暴涨3.9%至78.96美元/桶
items.summary: 美国总统特朗普7月13日宣布重启对伊朗船只封锁措施，伊斯兰革命卫队威胁拦截商船，约6000名船员被困，日均过境船只骤降。布伦特原油涨3.9%至78.96美元/桶；霍尔木兹海峡日均流通约2000万桶，占全球供应20%。
items.why: 地缘风险超级事件：能源成本上升压制消费信心与利润率，港股能源股短期受益；若冲突升级可能引发全球风险资产抛售。
items.source: 新华网 / CNBC / 联合国新闻

items.title: Nvidia Halves Asian AI Chip Buyer List in China Export Control Crackdown; Singapore, Malaysia, Japan Neo-Clouds Cut
items.summary: Nvidia implemented a new 'whitelist' system for Asian AI chip customers on July 14, cutting more than half of its prior customer base — particularly neo-cloud providers in Singapore, Malaysia, and Japan — after enhanced due diligence on ownership structures and end-use to prevent Chinese-linked entities from accessing restricted chips.
items.why: 出口管制升级再次收紧AI芯片流通渠道，短期影响英伟达亚洲收入预期；对全球AI基础设施供应链估值和相关期权的隐含波动率均有影响。

items.title: TAL Education Q4 FY2026: Revenue +31.5% to $802.4M, Non-GAAP Net Income Surges $7M → $254.5M; Q1 FY2027 Results July 30
items.summary: TAL reported Q4 FY2026 net revenues of $802.4M (+31.5% YoY) and non-GAAP net income of $254.5M (vs. $7M a year prior); gross margin rose to 53.2%, driven by AI-enhanced learning devices (X5 Ultra Classic), offline enrichment, and online learning. Q1 FY2027 results (ended May 31) will be released July 30.
items.why: 好未来利润从近乎为零飙升至2.545亿美元，盈利能力突破性改善；7月30日财报是下一个关键催化剂，AI教育硬件+学科培训复苏逻辑持续验证。

items.title: Korea's AI-Chip Rout Fires Seventh Circuit Breaker as KOSPI Plunges 8.95%; SK Hynix -15.37%
items.summary: SK Hynix collapsed 15.37% in Seoul on July 13 — its worst-ever single session — triggering a 20-minute market-wide circuit breaker (the 7th of 2026), with the KOSPI falling 8.95% to 6,806.93. Korean brokerage KIS projected SK Hynix Q2 operating profit at ~60.4 trillion won, ~8% below consensus, citing HBM long-term contract pricing that caps earnings upside even as spot DRAM/NAND surged 30-50%.
items.why: 韩国市场熔断是全球半导体最大系统性冲击事件，HBM长协价格压制盈利上行的逻辑同样影响美光(MU)和闪迪(SNDK)；港股科技股7月14日早盘同步承压。

items.title: 阿里巴巴7月8日大涨超12%：云收入增速约45%（远超预期），EBITA利润率大幅改善
items.summary: 阿里巴巴港股7月8日收涨逾12%（收107.50港元，前收95.80港元），为2025年9月以来最大单日涨幅，财报前瞻显示阿里云Q1 FY2027收入增速约45%（远超预期），EBITA利润率从约9.1%改善至低双位数，淘宝闪购亏损收窄快于预期。
items.why: 阿里云增速加速是最重要基本面改善信号；估值重估已在路上，接下来的正式财报是关键验证。
items.source: 澎湃新闻 / 新浪财经 / 东方财富

items.title: 美国6月CPI超预期，黄金7月13-14日重挫约1.5%至4,059美元/盎司，国内零售价降至1240元/克
items.summary: 美国6月CPI数据超预期，打压2026年降息预期，国际金价7月13-14日回落约1.5-1.7%至约4,059美元/盎司。国内多家主流黄金品牌将零售价集体下调至1,240元/克（较7月3日约1,260元下降）。
items.why: 金价大幅回落直接压制老铺黄金(6181.HK)股价，CPI超预期同时影响整体利率敏感型资产估值。

items.title: 小米汽车新款SU7 7月14日开启现车交付，锁单最快2小时可提车
items.summary: 小米汽车7月14日宣布部分新款SU7提供现车锁单，当天锁单最快2小时可到店提车；7月10-19日锁现车、8月31日前交付可获699元智能双表盘手表礼品。此举旨在加速交付节奏，应对年度55万辆目标的进度压力。
items.why: 现货交付说明交付节奏趋于顺畅，有助于消除产能爬坡担忧；持有1810.HK卖put者可视为边际正面信号。

items.title: 美团开源1.6万亿参数LongCat-2.0，全程国产AI芯片（5万张）训练，首个万亿级全链路国产部署
items.summary: 美团7月6日以MIT协议开源LongCat-2.0（1.6T总参数/48B激活），使用5万张国产AI芯片完成完整训练，原生支持100万token上下文，专为Agentic Coding设计；模型权重、推理代码和微调教程全部公开。
items.why: 美团AI技术实力展示，国产芯片全链路训练获政策加分；但市场更关心外卖/新业务盈利改善，AI研发投入对利润影响需持续跟踪。
items.source: 美团官方新闻中心 / 新浪科技 / OSChina

items.title: 美团Keeta出席巴西中资企业座谈会，获总理李强背书；沙特EBITA已于2026年初转正
items.summary: 中国国务院总理李强7月8日在里约出席中国企业座谈会，Keeta负责人周广宇代表互联网企业参会汇报境外扩张进展；Keeta同日参加金砖商业论坛。管理层披露沙特阿拉伯业务2026年初EBITA转正，全年新业务亏损指引80-100亿人民币。
items.why: Keeta获最高层政治背书有助于对冲里约暂停上线的负面预期；沙特转正是重要里程碑，对3690.HK国际化估值是边际正面信号。

items.title: Intel Falls 4.22% July 13, Now Down 21% in 7 Days Amid 18A Yield Concerns and AMD Data-Center Surge; Q2 Earnings July 23
items.summary: Intel (INTC) fell 4.22% to ~$104.81 on July 13, extending a 21% weekly slide driven by the semiconductor selloff, 18A foundry yield delay concerns, and AMD's first-ever quarter of higher data-center revenue than Intel. Intel confirmed Q2 2026 earnings release for July 23 after market close.
items.why: 英特尔周内跌21%，7月23日财报是极关键拐点催化剂；18A制程良率和代工客户进展将是市场焦点，期权隐含波动率财报前可能持续高企。

items.title: Alphabet Ends $346B Share Buyback to Fund AI Capex; Q2 Earnings July 22 (Google Cloud Was +63% in Q1)
items.summary: Alphabet formally ended its decade-long $346B share buyback program to pivot toward aggressive AI infrastructure spending, partly funded by an $84.75B equity offering (June 1). Q2 earnings confirmed for July 22; Google Cloud grew 63% YoY in Q1 with $36B capex deployed that quarter.
items.why: 回购终止意味着股东回报方式转变，股本摊薄是中期风险；但谷歌云Q1增速63%是极强基本面，Q2财报（7月22日）将验证加速能否持续——是关键期权时间节点。
items.source: Alphabet IR（官方）/ Motley Fool / CNBC

items.title: PDD Q1 Earnings -47%, US De Minimis Ended, EU Raids Dublin HQ; Temu Pricing Advantage Structurally Eroded
items.summary: PDD reported a 47% slump in Q1 earnings trailing consensus; the end of the US de minimis exemption for sub-$800 packages has materially eroded Temu's pricing advantage. EU regulators raided Temu's Dublin European headquarters under Foreign Subsidies Regulation, and Chinese SAMR investigated PDD's mainland facilities over its 'refunds first' policy.
items.why: 拼多多/Temu面临关税、监管双重打压，Q1盈利大跌47%是严重基本面信号；Temu去小额豁免（de minimis）影响最大，需观察Q2数据。
items.source: South China Morning Post / Yahoo Finance

items.title: 广西洪灾威胁蜜雪冰城茉莉花原料供应链；蜜雪捐款1000万元，但股价已跌至52周低点
items.summary: 广西横州是全球最大茉莉花产地，7月初台风洪灾可能扰动蜜雪冰城等茶饮品牌的茉莉花原料采购。蜜雪冰城7月7日向灾区捐款1000万元，旗下门店提供免费饮水充电服务。股价已从高点618.60港元回落至205.40港元（-61.5%），7月10日触及52周低点201.20港元。
items.why: 茉莉花供应链扰动若造成原料成本上升将进一步压制利润率，是Q3重点追踪指标；股价深度回调后卖put需关注基本面底部是否确立。
items.source: 新浪财经 / 北晚在线 / 公益时报

items.title: Keeta暂停里约热内卢上线，团队从236人缩至36人；约50%餐厅已签iFood排他协议
items.summary: 美团Keeta宣布无限期推迟里约热内卢业务上线，并将当地团队从约236人削减至36人，原因是约50%里约餐厅已与竞争对手iFood签有排他协议，超出原先预估。Keeta重申在巴西56亿雷亚尔（约5年）投资承诺不变，并集中资源于圣保罗。
items.why: 里约受阻是短期负面因素，但管理层以暂缓代替撤退；亏损指引区间较宽，需财报确认实际节奏。
items.source: DoNews / 电商派 / 网易财经

items.title: 小米SU7斩获6月及H1 2026 20万+纯电轿车双料销冠，YU7夺中大型SUV冠军
items.summary: 小米官方7月13日确认，新款SU7在6月单月和2026年上半年均拿下20万元以上纯电轿车销量第一；YU7同步夺得中大型纯电SUV单月及半年冠军，雷军在微博发文确认。
items.why: 销量双料冠军验证小米汽车产品竞争力，对1810.HK基本面构成实质支撑；H1成绩将成Q2财报重要看点。

items.title: 腾讯正式发布混元Hy3：295B参数MoE大模型，1元/百万tokens，全面集成元宝
items.summary: 腾讯7月7日发布混元Hy3（295B总参数/21B激活），支持256K上下文，定价1元/百万input tokens、4元/百万output tokens。内部270名专家盲测得分2.67/4，高于GLM5.1（2.51）。已全面集成元宝、WorkBuddy和Marvis产品。
items.why: 模型能力提升有助于缩小与字节豆包的差距，但商业化路径仍是最大疑虑；估值重估需等待元宝MAU数据改善。

items.title: SK Hynix 2x Leveraged ETFs SKUU (Long) and SKDD (Short) Launch on Nasdaq July 14 (GraniteShares)
items.summary: GraniteShares confirmed on July 13 that SK Hynix (SKHY) ADR is live on Nasdaq after raising $26.5B in the largest-ever foreign-company ADR listing (13% first-day gain), and that its 2x leveraged long (SKUU) and short (SKDD) ETFs launched on July 14, giving US retail investors direct leveraged exposure to HBM demand.
items.why: SKUU/SKDD上市为SK海力士提供更多美国散户参与渠道，但也会显著放大日内波动；HBM板块期权交易者需关注隐含波动率变化。

items.title: New Jersey Bill S1677 Would Effectively Ban Tesla Camera-Only Robotaxi; Requires LiDAR + Radar
items.summary: New Jersey's S1677 would require all autonomous vehicles to use cameras plus two additional sensing technologies (LiDAR and radar); Tesla's camera-only Cybercab fails this standard, while Waymo (which uses LiDAR) is unaffected. If passed, NJ would be the first state to legislatively ban Tesla's autonomy approach.
items.why: 州级立法威胁是Robotaxi扩张的系统性风险，若NJ成为先例可能引发其他州仿效；持有TSLA期权时需将监管不确定性纳入波动率定价。

items.title: 老铺黄金：金价从1月高点已跌25%+至约4059美元/盎司，品牌计划布局澳门和日本门店
items.summary: 国际金价持续从2026年1月高点约5,595美元/盎司大幅回落至约4,059美元（跌幅约25%+），国内黄金零售价7月14日降至1,240元/克。尽管老铺黄金继6月21日新加坡旗舰店开业后计划进一步布局澳门和日本，但股价已从52周高点1,102港元大幅回落至约380港元。
items.why: 金价持续下跌是老铺黄金最大近期压制因素；卖出6181.HK看跌期权时需设定保守行权价，等待金价企稳信号再加仓。
items.source: 新浪财经 / cngold.org / World Gold Council

items.title: 阿里巴巴连续两日各回购约5000万美元股份（7月6-7日），2026年回购节奏保持积极
items.summary: 阿里巴巴（9988.HK）7月7日回购407.6万股耗资4999万美元、7月6日回购410.9万股耗资4999万美元，合计约1亿美元；公司持续推进2026年大规模回购计划。
items.why: 连续大额回购是管理层对低估值的明确表态，有助于收缩股本支撑股价；对9988.HK卖put者是正面边际信号。
items.source: 电商派 / 证券之星（基于港交所披露）

items.title: 港股7月14日收盘：恒指涨0.52%至24,340点，PCB概念涨超14%，南向资金净流入109.97亿港元
items.summary: 恒生指数收涨0.52%至24,340.73，恒生科技指数微涨0.06%，国企指数涨0.46%。PCB概念（建滔积层板涨超14%）和有色金属（中国铝业涨超9%）领涨，科技股早盘下跌但午后逆转。南向资金单日净流入109.97亿港元。
items.why: 港股在美股下跌和韩市崩盘后展现韧性，南向资金净流入是关键支撑；AI板块内部分化明显，PCB/有色跑赢互联网科技。

items.title: UK Bank of England Begins Oversight of Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle as Critical Third Parties — July 13
items.summary: The Bank of England, PRA, and FCA formally began joint oversight of Google Cloud EMEA, AWS EMEA, Microsoft Ireland, and Oracle UK as 'Critical Third Parties' to the UK financial system effective July 13, following HM Treasury designation; this subjects Google Cloud to direct regulatory supervision, resilience requirements, and incident reporting.
items.why: AI基础设施走向受监管公共设施的里程碑事件，短期合规成本上升但对GOOGL估值影响有限；长期看是云服务商商业模式确定性提升的信号。
items.source: 英国央行（官方）/ GOV.UK / FCA

items.title: Interactive Brokers Q2 2026 Earnings July 21; Stock +35.3% H1 2026 as DART Surges +47% YoY; Korea Nextrade ATS Launched
items.summary: IBKR confirmed Q2 2026 earnings call for July 21 at 4:30 PM ET; stock rose 35.3% in H1 2026 driven by DART up 47% YoY in May and client equity up 49%. IBKR also launched Korean equity access via Nextrade ATS effective June 30 (first major US broker on Korea's new alternative exchange).
items.why: IBKR Q2财报（7月21日）将反映H1市场交易活跃度提升的受益程度；股价H1大涨35%，持仓者可评估covered call锁定部分收益。

items.title: McDonald's BT21 x Happy Meal Collaboration Launches July 14 with 10 Collectible Toys (BTS x LINE FRIENDS)
items.summary: Starting July 14, McDonald's US locations are offering a limited-time BT21 Happy Meal (BTS x LINE FRIENDS characters), featuring 10 collectible toys with QR codes for digital BT21 animation experiences; the collaboration targets Gen Z and young adult customers.
items.why: 麦当劳BT21联名是破圈营销事件，利用K-pop IP吸引年轻客群；类似过去Grimace系列带来的短期流量提升，对MCD是正面但量级有限的催化。

items.title: 携程发布2026年暑期旅游趋势：家庭游+13.6%，跨省游+22.4%，长途出行占比从28%升至47%
items.summary: 携程研究院7月3日报告显示，家庭出游预订量同比增13.6%，跨省游增22.4%，4天以上长途出行占比从28.4%升至47.1%。中国2026年暑运（62天）铁路预计旅客10.1亿人次、民航14.2亿人次。下一次携程财报安排于9月17日。
items.why: 暑运旅游量超预期增长直接利好携程GMV，高质量长途游提升客单价；9961.HK/TCOM财报（9月17日）是下一个检验节点。
